# SOUL.md Blueprint

> Runtime-neutral specification and engineering discipline for durable AI-agent identity.

## Canonical doctrine
- [Standard v1](./STANDARD-v1.md): Normative standard entrypoint.
- [Master Blueprint](./MASTER-BLUEPRINT.md): Complete human-readable doctrine.
- [AI Ingestion](./AI-INGEST.md): How an AI should consume and use this repository.
- [SOUL Engineering Skill](./SKILL.md): Operational workflows for creation, audit, refactoring, compilation and evaluation.
